==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ImageMagick&min=ImageMagick&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.ImageMagick: registers the stream converters for pdf, svg, png, webp and tiff, so
        // a document is snapshotted as one png per page rather than as bytes.
        // Despite what the readme says, Initialize() registers no comparers. It is still what marks
        // the plugin initialized, so it runs first: neither RegisterComparers() nor
        // RegisterPdfToPngConverter() sets that flag, and InitializePlugins() would call
        // Initialize() afterwards and overwrite whatever they had registered.
        VerifyImageMagick.Initialize();
        // Registers the image comparers: png, jpg, bmp, tiff and webp as streams, and svg as text.
        // The threshold is a fuzz distortion, so a lower number is stricter.
        VerifyImageMagick.RegisterComparers(threshold: .005);

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/ImageMagickTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ImageMagick&min=ImageMagick&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using ImageMagick;
using VerifyTestsImageMagick;

// Verify.ImageMagick: Renders pdf and svg to png through Magick.NET, and compares images with a fuzz tolerance.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.ImageMagick
// Note: Initialize() registers converters and no comparers, despite the readme saying it registers
// both.
// Note: Neither RegisterComparers() nor RegisterPdfToPngConverter() sets Initialized, so
// InitializePlugins() would still call Initialize() afterwards. That is why Initialize() is
// emitted first.
// Note: With the pdf-only role, delete the RegisterComparers line: the image comparers then come
// from another extension.
// Note: The per test settings live in the VerifyTestsImageMagick namespace, not in VerifyTests.
// Note: PagesToInclude and SkipPdfNormalization are also defined by the other pdf extensions, so
// with two of them referenced the fluent call is an ambiguous-call compile error.
// Note: Rendering a pdf shells out to Ghostscript; svg, png, webp and tiff do not need it.
// Note: ImageMagickPdfPassword("password") opens a password protected pdf.
// Note: The broadest target framework span of the extensions here: net48 through net10.0.
public class ImageMagickTests
{
    // An svg is verified twice: the markup as .verified.svg, and the rendered image as
    // .verified.png, so a change that only the renderer sees still shows up as a diff.
    [Fact]
    public Task Svg()
    {
        var svg =
            """
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="80" height="80">
              <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="30" fill="blue" />
            </svg>
            """u8.ToArray();
        var stream = new MemoryStream(svg);
        return Verify(stream, "svg");
    }
}


==== packages

Verify.XunitV3
xunit.v3
Verify.ImageMagick

==== interactions

Warning external-tool: ImageMagick needs Ghostscript: pdf pages are rendered by shelling out to Ghostscript; without it the conversion fails with exit code 127. Nothing else here needs it.
